newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank says bond stripping to start July 4.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank says bond stripping to start July 4.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Monday that stripping -- the separate trading of the principal debt and the coupon of a bond -- will start on July 4 for several government bonds.

The 30-year, 6.25 percent bond maturing January 4, 2024 bond, the 6.00 percent bond maturing on January 4, 2007 and the 6.00 percent bond maturing on July 4, 2007 will be strippable as well as the 30-year bond issue planned for the beginning of July, the Bundesbank said in a statement.
The Bundesbank had previously announced stripping would be allowed to help the German debt market compete with rival markets where bond stripping is standard practice.
